pretraining_correction: v1-v3 were superseded before any ceiling or formal registered-seed model fit. Explicit task scale 15,091,983 denotes coalesced directed pairs; exact-hop means first-reached hop (excluding 15 KCs reached at hop 2); hard-spike index_add is edge-binary; fan_in is the complete-graph incoming edge count rather than path-resolved count; and intermediate-hop ridge probes use a label-independent deterministic cap of the resolved KC width (2,544) so graph variants have equal readout parameter budgets. Development smoke tests exposed implementation mismatches; no registered accuracy, calibration, ceiling, or acceptance result had been computed.

claim_policy.a0_interpretation: input-information upper bound, never biological-wiring advantage

connectome.eye_definition: all rows in right_visual_positions_all_neurons.csv; root_id unique; x_axis/y_axis min-max mapped to the 32x32 stimulus plane
connectome.kc_definition: annotation cell_type starts with literal 'KC'; restrict to root_ids present in the complete biological graph; the resolved K=3 readout excludes KCs first reached at earlier hops
connectome.edge_weight: binary directed connection for index_add dynamics; syn_count retained unchanged for degree-null weight-multiset preservation and audit
connectome.fan_in: complete-graph incoming directed connection-edge count of each postsynaptic node; the denominator is computed before exact-hop path resolution

synthetic.name: SYNTHETIC_direction_diagnostic
synthetic.render_rule: binary filled circle; horizontal coordinates wrap modulo 32 so both directions have identical support statistics
synthetic.split: 70/30 StratifiedShuffleSplit, separately frozen by each registered seed
synthetic.flash_control: same circle geometry and per-frame Bernoulli visibility with p=0.5; direction labels retained but motion removed

davis.mask_rule: read official 480p indexed PNG masks; foreground is pixel value >0; union all foreground objects
davis.centroid_rule: for every frame compute the x centroid of all foreground pixels; require foreground in all eight frames; label 1 when least-squares x-centroid slope is positive and 0 when negative
davis.motion_margin_rule: discard a clip when absolute first-to-last fitted centroid displacement is below max(2 pixels, 0.005*frame_width)
davis.roi_rule: take the union foreground bounding box over the eight masks, expand each side by 10% of box size, clip to image, and use this one fixed ROI for all eight frames
davis.pixel_rule: multiply RGB JPEG by the frame foreground mask, crop the fixed union ROI, convert to ITU-R BT.601 grayscale, bilinear resize to 32x32, scale to [0,1]; no test-derived normalization
davis.balance_rule: after deterministic SHA-256 ordering of (sequence,start), retain equal left/right counts up to 400 total; never rebalance after seeing ceiling scores
davis.split_rule: 70/30 sequence-group split selected using each registered seed, with both classes required in both folds; no overlapping sequence across folds
davis.ceiling: ridge on all eight processed frames flattened; five registered seeds

sintel.download_rule: HTTP Range 64 MiB chunks with resumable .part files, Content-Range validation, per-chunk SHA-256 ledger, byte-exact concatenation, ZIP integrity test
sintel.flow_rule: read official training/flow .flo for each of seven adjacent frame pairs; within the fixed central ROI, pool all finite horizontal-flow values and use their median
sintel.flow_margin_rule: discard a clip when absolute pooled median horizontal flow is below 0.25 pixel/frame
sintel.roi_rule: full frame with a fixed 5% border removed on each side; no label-dependent or test-derived crop
sintel.pixel_rule: use official training/clean RGB frames, crop the fixed ROI, convert to ITU-R BT.601 grayscale, bilinear resize to 32x32, scale to [0,1]; no test-derived normalization
sintel.label_rule: 0 when pooled median horizontal flow < -0.25, 1 when > +0.25
sintel.balance_rule: after deterministic SHA-256 ordering of (sequence,start), retain equal left/right counts up to 400 total; never rebalance after seeing ceiling scores
sintel.split_rule: 70/30 sequence-group split selected using each registered seed, with both classes required in both folds; no overlapping sequence across folds
sintel.ceiling: ridge on all eight processed frames flattened; five registered seeds

graph.fallback_rule: use K=3 when at least one annotated KC is exact-hop reachable; otherwise choose the smallest K in 4..8 with nonzero annotated KC reachability; if all are zero use the nonzero hop among 2 then 3 with the largest reachable annotated-KC count; record the realized choice
graph.resolved_readout: all annotated KC root_ids exact-hop reachable at realized K, ordered by root_id
graph.spectral_radius_method: deterministic unweighted/binary connection-adjacency sparse power iteration, 100 iterations or relative change <1e-8
graph.exact_hop_definition: first-reached directed hop: remove all nodes reached at any shorter hop before counting the current frontier

degree_null.scope: complete edge table before exact-hop resolution
degree_null.algorithm: directed double-edge swaps; reciprocal directed pairs are swapped as undirected pairs and unilateral edges are swapped while rejecting self-loops, duplicate edges, or new reciprocal pairs

graph.identity: fixed information-preserving tiled identity from the 32x32 input plane to the resolved KC width; repeated unchanged at each hop
graph.a0: no graph propagation; fixed input-plane-to-KC tiled readout; explicitly an input-information upper bound

model.synapse_equation: syn_h = fan_in_gain * synaptic_scale * index_add(presyn_signal once per resolved directed connection edge) / complete_graph_binary_fan_in(post); syn_count is not multiplied into dynamics
model.lif_equation: v_h[t] = 0.6*v_h[t-1] + syn_h[t] + drive_h[t]; hard=1[v>=theta]; v_h[t] -= theta*hard
model.theta_zero_rule: theta=0 is the preregistered no-gate analog upper bound: propagation uses v_raw rather than hard; hard-spike-rate diagnostic remains fraction(v_raw>0)
model.soft_readout: mean over eight frames of sigmoid((v_raw-theta)*20)
model.stateless: each frame independently applies K resolved operators with tanh after every hop, then averages over eight frames

combo.ei_sign_rule: presynaptic top_nt acetylcholine=+1; gaba or glutamate=-1; all missing/other=+1

yoked_firing_rate.calibration_rule: for each graph and seed, run deterministic coarse-to-fine threshold search over [0,64] using only training examples and choose theta minimizing absolute KC hard-spike-rate error; ties choose larger theta; apply that theta unchanged to its stateless and LIF held-out evaluations

variance_information.mutual_information_estimator: mean per-dimension plug-in discrete mutual information with 8 train-quantile bins; train-derived bin edges applied unchanged to held-out examples
variance_information.noise_distribution: isotropic Gaussian generated by preregistered noise seed, centered per feature and globally rescaled on training data only

temporal_reduction.threshold_crossing_time: first crossing index divided by 8; no crossing encoded as 1.125

readout_states.pca_fit: training split only, deterministic full SVD, dimension min(64,n_train-1,n_features)
readout_states.equal_parameter_rule: every state is reduced to the same realized component count before the identical ridge
readout_states.random_projection_control: Gaussian projection to the same realized component count with preregistered seed and 1/sqrt(d) scaling

metrics.feature_std: mean across dimensions of sample standard deviation (ddof=1)
metrics.intermediate_hop_probe_dimension_rule: use all dimensions when <= resolved KC width; otherwise take 2,544 root-id-ordered evenly spaced dimensions, independent of labels/features, before StandardScaler+ridge; unsupervised full-layer dispersion remains computed on all dimensions
metrics.fisher: S_B/S_W where S_B is class-count-weighted squared distance of class means to global mean and S_W is total squared within-class deviation; zero denominator yields null unless numerator is positive, then infinity
metrics.class_mean_distance: Euclidean distance between class means divided by sqrt(feature dimension)
metrics.probe: StandardScaler fit on training features followed by RidgeClassifier(alpha=0.01) fit on training labels; held-out accuracy only
metrics.ci: paired-seed nonparametric bootstrap percentile 95% interval with 2000 resamples
metrics.exact_p: two-sided exact paired sign-flip test across five registered seeds
metrics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05 over the preregistered contrast family

invariants.kc_reachable_count: must report hops 1..8; fallback is allowed only by the frozen rule
invariants.kc_feature_std: never early-terminate; run all B/C/D/E/F/G diagnostics and classify one of COLLAPSE_UPSTREAM_OF_GATE, VARIANCE_RESTORED_INFO_LOST, or VARIANCE_AND_INFORMATION_RESTORED without turning the class into a superiority claim

acceptance.minimum_and_expected_strong_source: C1 guidance.md Expected Results; unchanged from attempts 1-3
